# Code index (generated by scripts/gen-code-index.py; do not edit)

One line per tracked script: path and its first comment line. Tests and archives/ are left out.
Regenerate with `python3 scripts/gen-code-index.py`; CI runs it with `--check`.

## (repo root)

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cleanup-legacy.ps1` | One-time cleanup for a PC that still has the old local web UI, watcher, or shortcut links. |
| `install-plugins.cmd` | Manual plugin install. Path-independent. Does not start at sign-in. |
| `install-plugins.ps1` | Open the claude.ai Plugins page and copy workstation-core for Cursor. |
| `install.cmd` | Run this clone's install.ps1. Path-independent. Arguments go through unchanged. |
| `install.ps1` | Workstation setup: shared Claude / Cursor memory, the Bridge toolkit and the 80% handoff hooks, for the CURRENT |
| `link-skills.ps1` | link-skills.ps1 - link this repo's skills into ~\.claude\skills as junctions (a git pull updates them). Cursor also reads |
| `ownership-notes.ps1` | ownership-notes.ps1 - add "owned by the workstation repo" notes to the folders install.ps1 creates. A note this script wrote (it starts with its own |
| `preflight.ps1` | Read-only check before installing the workstation setup: finds what is already installed, duplicates and conflicts. |
| `setup.ps1` | workstation setup (Windows). Safe to re-run. |
| `setup.sh` | workstation setup for WSL/Linux (optional Python helpers). Safe to re-run. |
| `uninstall.ps1` | Workstation setup: removes what install.ps1 added for the CURRENT user. Never deletes memory or project folders. |
